arg.help_help: show this help message and exit
arg.one_required: one of the arguments {names} is required
help.description: Probe an AI coding agent's sandbox with harmless canaries and catch silent regressions between versions.
help.epilog: Exit codes: 0 everything matches, 1 mismatch or regression, 2 could not run. Only the Bash/command boundary is measured.
help.self: run the probes inside the sandbox you are already in (ask your agent to run this)
help.run: run the probes through a target: wrap, srt or replay
help.diff: compare two saved results and report cells that went from blocked to allowed
help.init: write an expected-policy file from a preset
help.fingerprint: print a stable fingerprint of a settings file or a Seatbelt profile
help.convert: convert an agent CLI sandbox block into sandbox-runtime settings
opt.lang: output language: en or ko (default: SANDBOX_DRIFT_LANG, then LC_ALL, LC_MESSAGES, LANG)
opt.policy: expected-policy TOML file (default: a built-in preset)
opt.baseline: folder holding the previous result; the first run creates it, later runs compare
opt.update_baseline: overwrite the stored baseline after comparing
opt.outside_dir: folder used for the write-outside probe (default: your home folder)
opt.workdir: folder used for the write-inside probe (default: the current folder for self, a temp folder otherwise)
opt.format: output format: table, md or json
opt.out: write the result to this file instead of printing it
opt.strict: also fail when something became more closed or changed in another way
opt.exit_zero: report only: always exit 0 unless the runner could not run
opt.timeout: seconds to wait per network probe
opt.total_timeout: seconds to wait for the whole runner
opt.agent_version: agent version to record in the snapshot (or SANDBOX_DRIFT_AGENT_VERSION)
opt.docker_socket: docker socket path to probe (default: the standard location)
opt.target: where to run the probes: wrap, srt or replay
opt.wrap: runner template; {{}} is replaced by the worker command, e.g. "my-runner {{}}"
opt.settings: agent CLI settings.json (sandbox block) or srt settings file
opt.replay: saved snapshot to replay (practice mock, nothing is executed)
opt.python: python used to start the worker inside the runner
opt.init_out: write to this file instead of printing
opt.from_claude: agent CLI settings.json containing a sandbox block
report.title: sandbox-drift report
report.summary: PASS {pass}  FAIL {fail}  FLIP {flip}  ERROR {error}  SKIP {skip}  INFO {info}
report.scope: Measures the Bash/command boundary only. Tools that run outside the sandbox (file editors, MCP, hooks) are not covered.
report.replay_mock: Practice mock: replayed from a saved file, no sandbox was exercised.
note.example_flip: Practice mock: the observation shapes come from a real probe run, but the version change and the regression in the 'after' file were put in on purpose to show how a FLIP looks.
diff.title: sandbox-drift diff
warn.not_translated: warning: {key} has no sandbox-runtime equivalent and was left out
detail.self_no_home: self mode cannot swap HOME; run with --target wrap or srt
detail.localhost_ok: connected to the localhost canary listener
detail.no_proxy: no proxy variable set (the sandbox gave this process no proxy)
detail.no_docker_socket: no docker socket on this machine
detail.nested_ok: a nested sandbox could be created
err.hint_self: This is not a 'blocked' result. If you are already inside an agent sandbox, use `sandbox-drift self` instead.
err.output_unwritable: Cannot write {path} ({detail}). Choose a writable location with --out.
err.init_exists: {path} already exists. Use --force to overwrite it.
err.policy_not_found: Policy file not found: {path}. Create one with `sandbox-drift init --out {path}`.
err.policy_invalid_toml: Policy file {path} is not valid TOML ({detail}).
err.policy_no_expect: Policy file {path} has no [expect] table. Run `sandbox-drift init` for an example.
err.policy_unknown_probe: Policy file {path}: unknown probe {probe}. Known probes: {known}.
err.policy_bad_value: Policy file {path}: probe {probe} has value {value}; use one of: {allowed}.
err.settings_no_sandbox: No sandbox block found. Expected a "sandbox" key (agent CLI) or top-level "network"/"filesystem" keys (srt).
err.snapshot_no_probes: Snapshot {path} has no "probes" table. Was it written by sandbox-drift?
err.snapshot_bad_observation: Snapshot {path}: probe {probe} has an invalid observation; use one of: {allowed}.
err.wrap_no_placeholder: The --wrap template must contain {{}} where the worker command goes.
err.exec_timeout: The runner did not finish within {seconds} seconds.
err.worker_bad_json: The worker printed an unreadable result ({detail}).
err.nested_sandbox_apply: A sandbox cannot be created inside this sandbox ({detail}).
err.nested_listen_eperm: The runner could not open its proxy socket inside this sandbox ({detail}).
err.no_worker_output: The runner exited with code {rc} without a result ({detail}).
